title: Library
summary: Priya's Library with two products as dense license tiles (PX-35): the cover art in a 5:2 band, edge to edge, the 40 px icon over its lower edge with the name beside it, the tier and device pills with the platform glyphs, one line of facts (the duration) and the outlined action with More. The key tile 'Have a license key?' with Activate a license fills the rest of the last row. The page ends in the sticky 'Missing a license?' strip; there is no footer and no header Activate button (both in the account menu, portal.library-menu). The phone render shows a phone's actions (Email me the download for DJDL). Same DJDL license as licenses.detail.
compare: 2026-10-20 redraw (PX-35, BR-lockups, P0-36), to the owner-approved build. Owner, 2026-10-20: 'move Activate a License to the user dropdown menu since we already have a tile for it separately', 'tighten them up a bit to allow for more to show up', 'the missing a license section should be a sticky footer', 'we don't need the current Polaris Locker footer'. Changed: the header's Activate license button is gone (the account menu's first item; the key tile and the palette stay); the phone bar is Library · Discover, docked full width; the footer is gone (Help and Privacy are in the account menu); tiles are dense (5:2 art, 40 px icon, 12 px padding, one line of facts; 2/3/4/5 columns at 0/761/1180/1700 px); 'Missing a license?' is a sticky strip; the key tile reads 'Activate a license' (the catalog's common.activateLicense) and fills the rest of the last row; the header brand is the trimmed outlined Locker lockup at the guide's size (BR-lockups); dates are US 'Sep 14, 2027' (P0-36).

Header (64 px): the trimmed Polaris Locker lockup (40 px tall, 218 px wide; 36 px under 761 px; the mark alone, still named, under 384 px; never the mark beside live text), Library with its count (2) and the 3 px coral selected marker, Discover with no count when nothing can be added, the account chip (avatar, name and chevron from 1180 px, the avatar alone in its 40 px ring below). No Activate button at any width. Phone: lockup and avatar; the docked bottom bar is Library · Discover, the icon over the label, the current tab strong at 500 with the 3 px coral marker (D9a).

Grid (kit .portal-grid.dense, inside the portal's 1248 px content width): two columns on a phone, three from 761 px, four from 1180 px (1440: DJDL, Diceroll, the key tile over two cells), five from 1700 px; 12 apart, 16 from 761 px. The key tile fills the rest of the products' last row (one cell at 1024, two at 1440, three at 1920, the whole row on a phone), so no row ends in a hole.

Each tile: the cover art in a 5:2 band from the tile's top edge, edge to edge (the build fits the 16:9 header whole, over a blurred copy of itself, never a cropped band); the 40 px icon 16 over its lower edge with a 3 px ring, the name (16/22, two lines at most) beside it, clear of the art; one row of pills, the tier as a neutral pill with the key glyph ('Education', 'Standard') and the device count ('3/4 devices'), the platform glyphs at the end of the first pill line; one line of facts; the outlined action and More. A state pill (Expired, Suspended, Expires in …) sits on the art's top-right corner, 8 px in.

The whole tile, art included, opens the product page: the name's link is stretched over the tile and the buttons sit above it; the link's accessible name is the product name alone; hover lifts the tile 2 px and keyboard focus rings the whole tile.

Platform glyphs show platforms only, never stores: DJDL macOS and Windows; Diceroll iOS (the phone glyph, labelled iOS), Android, Windows and Linux. Steam, itch.io and the app stores appear as sources and store links, not glyphs. The glyph group is one image (role=img) named by its platforms ('macOS and Windows').

At the device limit the device pill turns warning with the alert glyph ('3/3 devices') and the quick action becomes Free a device. The art carries no second device-limit pill; it keeps status pills for other issues (Expired, Suspended, Expires in …).

One line of facts per tile (PX-35), the duration in LX-15's words: 'Updates until Sep 14, 2027' (DJDL), 'Lifetime' (Diceroll); elsewhere 'Renews <date>', 'Trial ends <date>', 'Updates ended at <version>', 'Ended <date>'. The rest of the split ('Then keeps the last version', 'Keeps working'), the source and the add-ons are on the license page (portal.license), not the tile. Dates in US form, 'Sep 14, 2027' (P0-36).

Source wording, on the license page since PX-35: 'Automatic grant' for an access-policy license on a Sign-in product (no key: LX-38, LX-39), 'Bought on the App Store' for a store license; sentence case from the copy catalog (P0-36), never 'Automatic Grant', 'From signing in' or a license type. Add-ons by their own names ('Add-ons: Polaris VPN, Stem separation, Extra devices (2)').
With several licenses for one product the tile describes the one rankLicenses() puts first (LX-10); the product page's switcher shows the rest.
Quick actions are outlined with the overflow menu; the solid ink primary stays reserved for the hero, the attention shelf and the product header.

Phone renders stand for a phone user agent; quick actions follow PORTAL.md §5.4's phone column, decided by the device, not the width: DJDL (no phone build) 'Email me the download'; Diceroll at its limit keeps 'Free a device' (otherwise 'Get it on the App Store' or 'Google Play'). A computer gets 'Download for macOS'. A tile under 208 px (two columns on a phone) stacks the icon above the name with More level with it, puts the pills and the glyphs on a line each, and drops the action's icon; the action spans the tile and may take two lines.
A tile's foot holds one quick action and the ⋯ at every width: 'Download for macOS' on a computer, 'Email me the download' on a phone (kit .ua-desk / .ua-phone), never both (the owner, 2026-10-09).

The key tile (kit .ptile.end-tile.entry-tile in the dense grid), last, as tall as the tiles beside it, dashed and unfilled, so it reads as a slot and never as a product: the key in a 40 px accent tile beside 'Have a license key?' (16/22), Activate a license (outlined, key glyph) at the foot, level with the tiles' Download and Free a device. With 640 px of its own (a whole row on a wide tablet) it is one line: the key, the title, the button on the right. It shows for two to seven products; the account menu, the palette and (when the key tile is absent) the strip reach the same dialog.

'Missing a license?' (PX-35) is the Library's slim strip, sticky to the window's bottom and resting at the page's end so it never covers the last row: full bleed, the raised surface, a hairline on top, no shadow. From 1180 px one line: 'Missing a license?', then 'Another email? Add it in Sign-in methods', 'Bought on Steam? Connect Steam', 'Bought in a store? Sign in from the app', the links 44 px tall in ink with the coral 2 px underline (D9a); 'Activate a license' leads the list only when no key tile shows (one product, eight and more, empty). Below 1180 px it is a closed 'Missing a license?' disclosure with a chevron that opens upward into a raised panel ('Other ways in'); on a phone it sits on the bottom bar. Escape and a press outside close it. It is a labelled region; a focused control never sits under it.
Subtitle 'Signed in as priya@example.edu' (portal-14), the one line of live state under the title; no product count (the nav's Library count has it).

Both themes: the tier pill text strong, the warning pill legible on light and dark, the lockup's light and dark artwork. No footer: Help and Privacy are the account menu's last group. Checks: no sideways scroll from 320 to 2560 px; axe 0 violations at 390, 1024, 1440 and 1920 in both themes; 200 % text without sideways scroll.

Portal v2 (B2, B12): the docked header, the one filled primary is ink, tile actions outlined, the page h1 at the display step (48/52, 32/36 on a phone) with no full stop or eyebrow, no glow or wash, no chartreuse; text never painted over art; weights 400/500/600.
Preserved (guide Ed. 04): The populated account (signed-in email) is shown
Preserved (guide Ed. 04): The duration line is shown (on the tile, its first part; the whole split on the license page)
Preserved (guide Ed. 04): Holder (automatic grant, bought on a store) and add-ons are shown on the license page (PX-35: the tile keeps one line of facts)
Preserved (guide Ed. 04): Real platform and download paths are kept

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Needs fixes, now applied: the phone render shows a phone's action (Email me the download), the bottom bar is the kit's, the whole tile is the link and the store path covers the App Store and Google Play; two PORTAL.md updates are left for the lead.

findings.issue: Phone render's DJDL action was 'Download for macOS'; PORTAL.md §5.4 gives a phone 'Email me the download'.
findings.resolution: Phone render now draws a phone's actions: DJDL 'Email me the download' (mail glyph) with the meta line 'macOS and Windows only'; Diceroll at its limit keeps 'Free a device'. Compare line added: phone renders stand for a phone user agent and follow §5.4's phone column.

findings.issue: Only Library drew Activate as the outlined pill in the phone bottom bar; the rule was scoped to this screen.
findings.resolution: Moved into kit/mockup.css (.portal-tabbar > a.act, plus the Discover .dot) and documented in kit/README.md; all four portal screens use class="act"; the screen-scoped rule is gone.

findings.issue: 'Missing a license?' had no path for App Store or Google Play buyers.
findings.resolution: Third row is now 'You bought it in a store': Steam through a sign-in method; App Store and Google Play by opening the game and signing in with this account once.

findings.issue: Holder line ended in the fragment '· new devices sign in'; '+2 devices' read as 'and 2 more'.
findings.resolution: Tile line is 'In your account · Automatic grant' (the license page's holder box says how a new device signs in). The seat pack is named 'Extra devices (2)', its name on licenses.detail, and never breaks across lines; the suggested '2 extra devices' would differ from the console's name for the same add-on.

findings.issue: Only the 16 px name was a link; the art did nothing.
findings.resolution: The name's link is stretched over the whole tile, art included, with the buttons above it; the accessible name stays the product name; hover lifts the tile 2 px. Compare line added.

findings.issue: At the limit, 'full' was carried only by colour and glyph.
findings.resolution: Pill reads '3 of 3 devices · full' (warning, kept over danger). PORTAL.md §5.3's Device limit row needs the same words: noted for the lead, since PORTAL.md is outside the mockups directory.

findings.issue: Full-page phone shots painted the fixed bottom bar (and Discover's toast) at the 844 px line, over the content.
findings.resolution: tools/mockups/shoot.mjs now draws .portal-tabbar and .toasts at the end of the page in phone shots, and the kit pads the footer clear of the bar (PORTAL.md §3.2: the footer sits above the bottom bar). Affects every portal-surface screen; noted in the mockups README, the kit README and shoot.mjs.

findings.issue: 'Missing a license?' stretched to tile height with a 130px hole and repeated Activate license and Sign-in methods three times.
findings.resolution: A quiet full-width help strip under the grid: three one-line rows, one Activate it link, one Sign-in methods link, no second button.

findings.issue: The add-ons row wrapped, so DJDL had four meta rows to Diceroll's three and the buttons sat at different heights; pill rows wrapped differently on phone.
findings.resolution: Add-ons collapse to '3 add-ons' / '1 add-on'; device pills are '3/4 devices' and '3/3 devices' (warning style when full); the page subtitle is '2 emails'.

findings.issue: Card art too tall, and the wide layout was not designed.
findings.resolution: Art 16:7 capped at 140px (112px on phone); content max-width 1520px from 1700px; tile grid auto-fit from 380px.

findings.issue: Replace 'Automatic grant' with 'Included with your Education email'.
findings.resolution: declined: The consolidation plan records 'Automatic grant' as adopted, in sentence case, and P0-36 moves it to the copy catalog.

findings.issue: Show 'Free a device' as primary only when full, and add vendor lines to Library tiles.
findings.resolution: declined: Both change structure and content; the tile already uses the full pill as its signal.

findings.issue: Move the helper strip to a 320px right rail, or use four tile columns with an end tile.
findings.resolution: declined: A rail or a fourth tile brings back the panel that is being demoted. A strip under the grid is simpler and holds at every width.
